hints.title: Relate to Longest Palindromic Subsequence
hints.text: A string can become a palindrome with at most k deletions if its longest palindromic subsequence length is at least n - k.

hints.title: Compare String with its Reverse
hints.text: The longest palindromic subsequence of string s equals the longest common subsequence of s and reverse of s.

hints.title: Evaluate Remainder Bound
hints.text: Compute the maximum subsequence match length; if the original length minus this match is less than or equal to k, return true.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all combinations of up to k deletions incurs exponential branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dynamic programming on substrings solves the longest palindromic subsequence in quadratic time with linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize the equivalence between minimum character deletions and longest palindromic subsequence.
complexity.notes: Space can be optimized to O(N) by keeping only the previous DP row.
